newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium issued 700 bln bfr of bonds in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Belgium issued 700 bln bfr of bonds in 1996.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury has issued bonds, mainly linear ones, worth 700 billion francs so far in 1996, a figure comparable to last year, the Belgian Primary Dealers Association said in its newsletter.
It added that the share of exchange auctions in the total amount of OLOs issued is 50 percent, compared to 20 percent in 1995.
This is due to the existence of two linear bond (OLO) lines which mature in 1996 (redeemed) and three with final maturity in 1997.
The letter also said that the Treasury intends to further smooth out its schedule of maturities and will therefore propose to continue the exchange of 1998 OLO lines next year.
At exchange auctions, banks can exchange OLOs close to maturity for OLOs with expiry dates that are further away.
